selection_rule: Retain all 15 pilot instances. Include all 15 files in the SchedulingLab Brandimarte distribution. From each of the 8 JSP and 12 PFSP Taillard size blocks and 12 Behnke-Geiger FJSP job/machine size blocks, select the two identifiers with the smallest SHA256(salt|kind|id). Union and deduplicate; no outcome-dependent exclusions or replacements.
parallelism_note: User requested parallel local experiments before execution. Eight independent single-worker runs execute concurrently. Host contention and CPU heterogeneity affect wall times and watchdog outcomes; these timings cannot support isolated runtime or speedup claims. No LLM/API calls, subscriptions or agent monitoring are used during execution.
timeout_policy: Identical per-run process watchdog for every method, including startup, imports, serialization and final audit. Terminate that run's process tree; retain a timeout row. Do not retry selectively or replace an instance. No quality is imputed when no final audited archive was exported. This is a safety cap, not an equal-time experiment.
objective_scale: MS/S and FT/(n*S), S=sum of maximum eligible operation durations
comparisons: Same contemporary frozen code and matrix for all methods. Show every per-instance result and coverage by class, cohort and operation band. Primary quality contrasts use instance-seed blocks completed validly by all 12 methods. Also report conditional available-run summaries labelled as such. Do not declare a global winner if coverage differs.
inference: Descriptive paired comparisons, seed medians within instances, then equal instance weights. Three seeds do not justify broad significance or state-of-the-art claims. No p-values. F repeats are timing repetitions.
known_prior_results: The earlier 15-instance pilot and XE follow-up are known. Current algorithm defaults include development informed by that work. Freeze this expanded selection before obtaining its new results; do not call it independent confirmation or external preregistration.
scope_limits: Complete implementation comparisons, including different decoders, language, validation overhead and default populations. 1000 evaluations is a modest fixed search budget, especially for large instances. Standard pymoo adapters are not tuned scheduling state-of-the-art solvers. Large standard subsets do not validate industrial extensions or agent productivity.
failure_reporting: Include timeouts, exceptions, invalid schedules, incomplete evaluation allowances and missing runs explicitly. Report quality only after independent schedule validation. Preserve original pilot artifacts.
tuning: None during this matrix; no source, parameter, sample or budget adaptation based on results. Any correction requires a new run and a documented reason.
